PartnershipAgreement.name: PartnershipAgreement
PartnershipAgreement.description: Represents a formal, renewable agreement that defines and governs an institution’s relationship with an external organization, including the scope, duration, and expected outcomes of corporate, research, and workforce partnerships.

AccountId.description: The organization that's associated with the partnership agreement.

Category.description: Specifies the category of the partnership agreement, for example, training agreement.

ContractId.description: The contract that's associated with the partnership agreement.

DataClassification.description: Specifies the data classification of partnership agreement, for example, HIPAA.

DepartmentId.description: The department that's associated with the partnership agreement.

DetailedSummary.description: The detailed summary of the partnership agreement.

EndDate.description: The end date of the partnership agreement.

EngagementModel.description: Specifies the engagement model of the partnership agreement, for example, grant.

HasSponsoredResearch.description: Indicates whether the partnership agreement includes a research component.

IndicatorAssignmentId.description: The indicator assignment that's associated with the partnership agreement.

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last accessed this record indirectly, for example, through a list view or related record.

LastViewedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last viewed this record or list view. If this value is null, and LastReferenceDate is not null, the user accessed this record or list view indirectly.

Name.description: The name of the partnership agreement.

OwnerId.description: The ID of the owner of this object.

RenewalDate.description: The next renewal date of the partnership agreement.

ShortSummary.description: The short summary of the partnership agreement.

StartDate.description: The start date of the partnership agreement.

Status.description: Specifies the status of the partnership agreement, for example, on hold.

PartnerReferenceNumber.description: The reference number of the partner insitution that returned the learner during a learning.

PartnershipAgreement.accessRules: These fields are available only if United Kingdom Compliance and Configuration is turned on.
